title: Power Rankings: Chicago Bulls rise to No. 1
heading: 2011-12 Power Rankings: Week 3
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Of the many reasons they're up here now: The Bulls have played five games at home, and in precisely none of those five did the visitors manage to score 75 points. As long as D-Rose's toe troubles don't linger, they'll be hard to dislodge from this perch.

rankings.summaryHtml: Anyone out there worried that Durant doesn't have a 30-point game yet in 2012? Please. The overriding concern in OKC, if there is one, is figuring out whether they really can get by for a whole season without the quiet composure they get from Eric Maynor.
